reference: Eavor (23 June 2023), FORGE Insulated Drill Pipe Trial Results
locator: GDR 1516 archive; Eavor FORGE Insulated Drill Pipe Trial Results - 23 June 2023 (003).pdf; PDF p5, IDP Trial Operational Summary and Table 1; p6, Table 1 continuation; p11, IDP Mechanical Wear. Cross-check: End of Well Report p266, daily report 39.
finding: Eavor BHA 11 and 12 are EOW 18 and 19. Regular pipe is below insulated pipe on the partial trial. An internal coating is present as well as external insulation: coating debris was reported near 8400 ft and a few joints showed internal delamination, with negligible external wear. The daily report independently confirms the order.
applicability: No quantitative coating thickness, coated bore or hydraulic roughness is supplied. Regular-pipe internal condition is unrecorded. Coating offers a physical explanation for a lower friction factor if the bore is smoother, but neither friction reduction nor an installed pressure loss is measured by this report.

reference: Scientific Drilling International, Drilling Motor Handbook, version 2.02.5

finding: The 7.15 in 6/7-lobe 7.1-stage TiTAN22 has speed ratio 0.23 rev/gal and maximum differential 1670 psi. The summary lists 500-750 gpm; the detail sheet lists 350-750 gpm. Its configuration can be compared with the source records in 16b-motor-records.
applicability: No numerical off-bottom/no-load loss is specified for this model. Loaded differential and maximum bit pressure-drop ratings are not motor no-load loss. The flow-range discrepancy is unresolved. No test-flow reference or loss coefficient is selected. Some source drawings have differing dimensions or torque ratings; configuration agreement is not exact agreement of all specifications.
